items.titulo: Linkup Research Releases SPARSEUP: A 149M-Parameter Open-Source Sparse Embedding Model
items.resumen: Linkup Research has released SPARSEUP, an open-source sparse embedding model built on a 149M-parameter ModernBERT backbone. It scores 56.4 nDCG@10 on BEIR-13, which Linkup calls the best result it knows of for a public sparse encoder under 150M parameters. The model uses a logit shift, top-12 expansion per token and case folding to keep its vectors sparse.
